svg.title: Estimated GPU memory for fine-tuning Llama-3.1-8B: full fine-tuning about 135 GB, LoRA about 23.6 GB, QLoRA about 13.2 GB, with 24 GB and 80 GB capacity lines.

g.text: Logits 4.2 GB = plain PyTorch or the Trainer; TRL v1.15's SFTTrainer computes them in chunks by default (≈0).

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b
font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #86868b

g.text: Estimate (formulas in C1): Llama-3.1-8B, sequence 4096, batch 1, activation recomputation on; GB = 10⁹ bytes
